english.title: Obstruct an authorised person exercising a s.50(3)(b) power to recover an abducted child
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), an authorised person exercising a power under section 50(3)(b) of the Children Act 1989 to remove a child in accordance with a recovery order made at **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ORDER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(9) and (10) of the Children Act 1989.
